review.title: Insert one change after a destination

pixel_review.summary: The opaque destination selector shows revision-only scope and insert after (-A), with the searched Rebase destination candidate and readable navigation hints. The real source/destination/base graph remains visible above. Source is identified only by a short hash and the background source cursor still looks active.

text_style_review.summary: State matches revision only (-r), insert after (-A), /Rebase destination and the selected described candidate. The panel uses #242c3a, bold teal #65d4cf controls and #e0e6ee text. The source hash must be matched to the still-emphasized background graph.

pixel_review.summary: The opaque preview keeps the real graph visible and fits the revision-only explanation, placement effect, amber history warning, exact command and all four controls. Full operand hashes lack descriptions. The repository path wraps mid-component without clipping; the background selection stays emphasized.

text_style_review.summary: State confirms full source/destination IDs, revision only (-r), and the placement explanation: Inserts after (-A), rewriting existing descendants, including other workspaces. The command has the matching placement flag and complete operands. Amber #eab855 marks the history warning; teal controls contrast with the slate panel. The description-free IDs and active background selection remain UX-04/06.

pixel_review.summary: The refreshed graph visibly places the selected Rebase source above Rebase destination and Rebase base. Its source commit changes while the change ID is retained. The success toast and undo/history/operations affordances are readable. This configured log omits descendants; their resulting relationships are established by the passed repository assertions.

text_style_review.summary: Viewport text confirms the source/destination/base chain, rewritten source commit, retained change ID and Rebased revisions. Native jj colors and bold working-copy selection remain intact. Passed repository assertions separately establish source content, both descendant groups and source-descendant reconnection to the old parent. The insert-after assertion also establishes relocation of the old destination descendant under the source.

pixel_review.summary: Command History clearly marks Rebase revisions as successful and fits the complete “Rebased 1 commits to destination.” summary. The selected row and details/operation/copy controls are readable.

text_style_review.summary: State confirms ok, log rebase, Rebase revisions and the complete stderr summary. Green #52aa60 status and teal #269d9a command source distinguish the successful action; its selected title is bold and the footer is unobscured.

video_review.summary: Review method: inspected all four PNG checkpoints inline, matching viewport text/styled spans, captured source tape, ffprobe duration 16.066667s at 1400x900/15fps, and actual MP4 samples at 2.41, 8.03 and 13.66s. Samples show the insert after (-A) selector/input, complete preview, and successful command-history row. The source uses 80ms typing and 2–3s semantic holds with setup hidden. The configured log shows source/destination/base only; passed repository assertions establish the omitted descendant outcomes.
